checklist.means: Typed input schema; arguments checked once, at the door, with a readable error.

checklist.item: Errors that say what to do next
checklist.means: Every failure returns ok=false, what went wrong, and next_step.
A write previews first (confirm=false) and commits only on confirm=true.
A retry with the same key returns the first result, never a second document.
The document's real status, read back from Bahi after the write.
Bahi's procedures enforce the rules; the tool asks them, never copies them.
The tool runs in the user's own Bahi session, never a service account.
Reads retry; a write that times out is looked up by its key before anything else.
Each tool has a version number, carried on receipts and published over MCP.

tools.name: find_item
tools.description: Find stock items by description or code (e.g. '5 litre silicone gasket'). Returns active items, best match first, with their code, unit and whether they touch food.

tools.name: stock_position
tools.description: Stock on hand, on order and days of cover for an item, in every warehouse.

tools.name: last_purchase
tools.description: Recent released orders for an item (supplier, quantity, rate, date) and each supplier's CURRENT contract rate. Use the contract rate for a new order, not an old order's rate.

tools.name: find_supplier
tools.description: Look a supplier up by name, tolerating different spellings. Returns the closest matches with their status and food-grade certificate. ALWAYS use this before registering a supplier.

tools.name: check_cost_centre
tools.description: Is a cost centre open, and how much budget is left this quarter? Without a code, lists every open cost centre.

tools.name: create_purchase_order
tools.description: Order an item from a supplier. With confirm=false (the default) it only PREVIEWS: price, tax, gross value, whether approval is needed and who approves. Show the preview to the user; call again with confirm=true to commit. Above ₹50,000 it raises the purchase request first; if that needs approval it returns WAITING FOR APPROVAL and you call again with the same arguments once approved. Returns a receipt with the real status.

tools.name: release_purchase_order
tools.description: Release an APPROVED order to the supplier. Returns a receipt with the real status.

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: The real status of a purchase order, with its approval and any warning, read from Bahi.

tools.name: amend_purchase_order
tools.description: Change an order's quantity, need-by date or cost centre (e.g. to move a DRAFT off a closed cost centre). Bahi re-checks budget and approval. Returns a receipt with the real status.

tools.name: register_supplier
tools.description: Register a NEW supplier. Only after find_supplier shows no existing match and the user has confirmed the details. Food-contact parts still need a food-grade certificate before any order.

tools.name: record_certificate
tools.description: Record a supplier's food-grade certificate that the user has provided (document reference and expiry). Never invent one.
